import re, datetime

print('has gmail_access_token', 'gmail_access_token' in globals())
print('gmail_access_token_present', bool(globals().get('gmail_access_token','')))

venmo_thread_ids = [47829, 47831, 47827]

codes = []
for tid in venmo_thread_ids:
    thr = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=globals()['gmail_access_token'])
    # find email that looks like password reset (subject contains 'Venmo Password Reset Code')
    bodies = [e['body'] for e in thr.get('emails', [])]
    subjects = [e.get('subject','') for e in thr.get('emails', [])]
    print('thread', tid, 'subjects', subjects)
    for b in bodies:
        # try extract: 6-digit code
        m = re.findall(r'\b(\d{6})\b', b)
        if m:
            print('  found 6-digit codes', m)
            codes.extend([(tid, '6digit', c, b[:80]) for c in m])
        # try generic alphanum length 4-12
        m2 = re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z0-9]{4,12})\b', b)
        if m2:
            # print some candidates
            cand = [x for x in m2 if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in x)]
            print('  found alphanum candidates sample', cand[:10])
            # do not automatically choose
    print('---')

print('total_extracted', len(codes))
for item in codes[:10]:
    print(item)
